name: Aragami Sayo
source: The mayor of Aqua Eden. Her appearance is that of a loli, but she is actually a 500 year old vampire. She has exceptional powers even compared to others of her kind. She promotes the idea of human and vampire coexisting, and became the mayor of the island city to achieve that goal. She seems to be somewhat sensitive about her age, as she claims initially that she is only over 200 years old.
